surface_name: Cloud Firestore web SDK, write serialization
title: Firestore setDoc fails with Unsupported field value: undefined
symptoms: FirebaseError: Function setDoc() called with invalid data. Unsupported field value: undefined (found in field middleName in document users/abc)
Same error from updateDoc and addDoc
Fails only when an optional form field is left empty
cause: The SDK throws on any property set to undefined unless the Firestore instance was created with ignoreUndefinedProperties. The default is to throw.
fix: Initialize Firestore with ignoreUndefinedProperties true, or strip undefined fields before writing. Use null when you want the field stored as empty.
affected: Every Firebase JS SDK version and firebase-admin Firestore throw by default; the ignoreUndefinedProperties setting exists since @firebase/firestore 1.14.6 (mid-2020)
